content: 1 God raigneth, the people be in a rage: he sitteth betweene the Cherubims, the earth quaketh. 2 God is great in Sion: and high aboue all people. 3 They shall prayse thy name great & dreadfull: for it is holy, and a kynges power that loueth iudgement. 4 Thou hast ordeyned all thynges accordyng to equitie: thou hast caused iudgement and iustice to be in Iacob. 5 Magnifie God our Lorde: and kneele downe before his footstoole, for it is holy. 6 Moyses & Aaron among his priestes, and Samuel among such as call vpon his name: these called vpon God, and he hearde them. 7 He spake vnto them out of the cloudy pyller: for they kept his testimonies, and the lawe that he gaue them. 8 O God our Lord thou heardest them, O Lorde thou didst forbeare them: and thou tokest auengement for their owne inuentions. 9 Magnifie God our Lorde, and kneele downe before his holy hyll: for God our Lorde is holy.
